name: rosetta-factors-of-an-integer
code:
use default

factors(n: int) -> Ghul.Pipes.Pipe[int] =>
    (1::n) |> filter(d => n % d == 0)

for n in [1, 45, 53, 64, 1024] do
    write_line("{n,4}: {factors(n) |> join(", ")}")
od
